en: A New Student in Our Class

intro.uz: Nilufar dugonasi Azizaga elektron xat yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: sinfingizga boshqa davlatdan oʻquvchi kelsa, unga qanday yordam berasiz?

paragraphs.en: Hi Aziza, how are you? I have got some news. We have got a new student in our class! His name is Min-jun, and he is from Seoul, South Korea. His father works in Tashkent now.
paragraphs.uz: Salom, Aziza! Qalaysan? Menda bir yangilik bor. Sinfimizga yangi oʻquvchi keldi! Uning ismi Min-jun, u Janubiy Koreyaning Seul shahridan. Uning otasi hozir Toshkentda ishlaydi.

paragraphs.en: Min-jun is twelve, like me. He is short and he has got black hair and glasses. He is very friendly. He can speak Korean and English, but he can't speak Uzbek yet.
paragraphs.uz: Min-jun ham men kabi oʻn ikki yoshda. U past boʻyli, sochi qora va koʻzoynak taqadi. U juda samimiy. U koreys va ingliz tillarida gapira oladi, lekin hali oʻzbekcha gapira olmaydi.

paragraphs.en: In the lessons, he sits next to me. I help him with Uzbek words, and he helps me with English. He is very good at maths and art.
paragraphs.uz: Darslarda u mening yonimda oʻtiradi. Men unga oʻzbekcha soʻzlarda yordam beraman, u esa menga ingliz tilida yordam beradi. U matematika va tasviriy sanʼatni juda yaxshi biladi.

paragraphs.en: Min-jun loves Uzbek food. His favourite is plov! Can you come to our school next week? You can meet him. Write soon! Nilufar
paragraphs.uz: Min-jun oʻzbek taomlarini juda yaxshi koʻradi. Uning eng sevimlisi — palov! Kelasi hafta maktabimizga kela olasanmi? U bilan tanishasan. Tezroq javob yoz! Nilufar
